_comment: Container images mirrored under Diction Labs. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
`upstream_digest` is the digest we have promoted — what our :tag actually serves.
scripts/diction-image-mirror.sh reconciles the registries to match this file, and alerts
when upstream has moved past it. Promotion is deliberate: review the upstream change, test,
then bump the digest here. Never let the script auto-follow upstream.
Deliberately NOT mirrored: ollama/ollama and cloudflare/cloudflared. Both are actively
maintained by well-resourced teams and ship security fixes on their own cadence; inserting
ourselves as a middleman makes us a staleness risk with no offsetting benefit. See

images.name: whisper-server
images.note: M2 (2026-07-29): repointed from abandoned fedirz/faster-whisper-server to speaches-ai/speaches (the official successor). Breaking changes vs fedirz: WHISPER__MODEL/WHISPER__INFERENCE_DEVICE env vars removed (model now specified per-request via ForwardModel); volume path changed from /root/.cache/huggingface to /home/ubuntu/.cache/huggingface/hub.

images.name: parakeet
images.note: Promoted 2026-11-07 (#27): upstream v0.10.0 + self-host model export (3a0edc69). Same baked-in istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-onnx weights plus a bundled, opt-in diarization model; models flat under /models with diarization in /models/diarization (checked in the image 2026-11-08; only matters if you mount your own); API and {text} response unchanged. Tested vs previous pin on 186 clips (en/cs/de/fr/es/pl): WER 21.0% -> 12.0%, same latency. Single-maintainer project. Apache-2.0 requires preserving NOTICE and stating changes; we copy the manifest unmodified, so nothing is changed and attribution lives in the repo description.

models.licence: CC-BY-4.0 (NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3; ONNX conversion by istupakov)

images.models_note: Every model file in this image has an unmodified copy on DictionLabs Hugging Face, mirrored from the source revision above; sha256 of each mirrored file equals the file in the image at this upstream_digest (verified 2026-11-08). The image itself still carries its own baked-in copy and does not download anything; upstream offers no setting to change the model source, so this is a fallback, not a dependency. Re-mirror and re-verify whenever upstream_digest changes.
